definitions.explanation: Fine particles of matter that accumulate on surfaces or float in the air. Also used figuratively for impurities or worldly attachments.

examples.english: Dust has accumulated on top of the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる→塵も積もれば山となる：06195_chirimotsumorebayamatonaru⟧。
examples.english: Even dust, when piled up, becomes a mountain. (Many a little makes a mickle.)

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{塵|ちり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がって→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧そうになった。
examples.english: When the wind blew, the dust swirled up and nearly got in my eyes.

notes:
PROVERB:
⟦{塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる→塵も積もれば山となる：06195_chirimotsumorebayamatonaru⟧ — "Even dust piles up into a mountain." A well-known proverb meaning that small amounts accumulate into something significant.

USAGE:
{塵|ちり} refers to very fine particles — finer than ⟦{埃|ほこり}→埃：03624_hokori⟧ (dust, in everyday speech). In everyday conversation, ⟦{埃|ほこり}→埃：03624_hokori⟧ is more common for household dust. {塵|ちり} appears more in literary contexts and set phrases. The pair {塵|ちり}{芥|あくた} means "dust and rubbish" — worthless things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塵|ちり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}もる→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧: dust accumulates
- {塵|ちり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: dust swirls
- {塵|ちり}ひとつ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not a speck of dust
- {塵|ちり}{芥|あくた}: dust and rubbish, worthless things

SIMILAR WORDS:
{塵|ちり} is literary and refers to very fine particles. ⟦{埃|ほこり}→埃：03624_hokori⟧ (dust) is the everyday word for household dust. ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (garbage, trash) is broader and refers to waste in general.
